verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents uv's built-in commands (project management, tool install/run, pip interface, caching, Python version management) but contains no mention of a plugin architecture, third-party taps, overlays, or pluggable backend system that developers could extend uv with. Community comments even note uv 'tries to do too many things' as a monolithic tool rather than an extensible one, reinforcing the absence of a plugin ecosystem.
